title: Detection of Atrial Fibrillation Using a Ring-Type Wearable Device (CardioTracker) and Deep Learning Analysis of Photoplethysmography Signals: Prospective Observational Proof-of-Concept Study.
summary: The JMIR v1 article reports a prospective proof-of-concept in which a deep-learning algorithm analyzed ring-device PPG to detect atrial fibrillation, with cardiologist/ECG validation and 100 participants.
ai_technology: The learned algorithm analyzes ring-device PPG signals for AF classification.
organization: Not stated in the abstract reviewed

evidence.tested: The study reports 96.9% accuracy, 99.0% sensitivity and 94.3% specificity in 100 participants.
evidence.unknown: Reference ECG and healthy sinus-rhythm subjects provide bounded clinical validation.
evidence.ai_role: The learned algorithm analyzes ring-device PPG signals for AF classification.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
